scripts.dev: npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/contracts run build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm.cmd run dev:server" "npm.cmd run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/contracts run build && npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/server run build && npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/contracts run build && npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/server run typecheck && npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/web run typecheck
scripts.desktop: npm.cmd run build && npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm.cmd run build && npm.cmd --workspace @atelier/desktop run build
